name: tideways-mcp-server
description: Query Tideways PHP performance monitoring data (performance, issues, traces, history) from your AI assistant.
long_description: Read-only MCP server for [Tideways](https://tideways.com/). Its tools cover the token's projects and services, per-minute performance and top transactions, the timeline of one transaction, 15-minute summaries over 30 days, error, slow-SQL, deprecation, warning and notice issues with their stack traces, individual traces, day/week/month reports and automatic configuration and bottleneck observations.

tools.name: tideways_list_projects
tools.description: Projects and scopes of the API token, and the organization's rate-limit status

tools.name: tideways_list_services
tools.description: Services seen in issues of all services; with a search word, the services that serve it

tools.name: tideways_get_performance
tools.description: Per-minute performance and top transactions for any window of up to 24 h within the last ~30 days

tools.name: tideways_get_transaction
tools.description: Per-minute timeline, layers and response-time histogram of one transaction

tools.name: tideways_get_performance_summary
tools.description: 15-minute requests, errors and p95 over up to 30 days

tools.name: tideways_list_issues
tools.description: Errors, slow SQL, deprecations, warnings and notices of all services, 10 per page with totals

tools.name: tideways_get_issue
tools.description: One issue's stack trace, request context, affected transactions and occurrence histogram

tools.name: tideways_search_traces
tools.description: Individual request traces with bottlenecks and slowest layers

tools.name: tideways_get_history
tools.description: Day, week or month performance report

api_token.title: Tideways API token
api_token.description: API token created under Organization settings → API Access (scopes: metrics, traces, errors).

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Tideways organization (optional; derived from the token).

project.title: Project
project.description: Default project, "project" or "organization/project" (optional if the token reaches one project).

service.title: Service
service.description: Default service, e.g. web (optional; API default is the project's default service).
